gaps.item: No documented discharge plan or discharge criteria in any note; treatment plan says discharge plan to be determined
gaps.why: A reviewer cannot assess the step-down or discharge pathway without a documented plan.

gaps.item: Concurrent review request for November 4 through November 6 is a draft with no documented submission or decision
gaps.why: Authorization approved only through November 3, so the status of any additional days is unclear.

gaps.item: Initial treatment plan dated 2026-11-01 (version 1) has no documented update and no signature
gaps.why: The plan does not reflect the day 2 and day 3 status, and a reviewer needs a current signed plan.

gaps.item: Conflicting documentation of intent: intake records intent to act this weekend while the day 1 progress note records intent uncertain
gaps.why: Conflicting intent documentation affects how the risk picture is interpreted.

gaps.item: Day 2 progress note is a late entry signed November 3 with no original entry time documented
gaps.why: A reviewer needs to know when the day 2 status was actually documented.

gaps.item: No structured risk instrument repeated in progress notes after intake; safety plan exists only as a first draft on 2026-11-02
gaps.why: Current risk status and safety planning progress are not fully documented.

gaps.item: Family meeting not held as of 2026-11-03; sibling unavailable until November 4
gaps.why: Family involvement and the home support plan are undocumented, which a reviewer would ask about.

gaps.item: Day 2 plan to address medication side effects does not specify the intervention or sertraline dose change
gaps.why: Medication plan and response to refused doses are unclear.
